claude.performance_metric: ~$99.3M pre-tax restructuring/transaction costs; folded into acquirer segments by FY2020; ~$475M legacy-JV settlement (2022) with $91.3M additional pre-tax charge
claude.rationale: The realized record shows a routine, largely successful integration: CH2M contributed ~$3.8B revenue and $185.9M pretax income in the partial first year, its operations were folded into the acquirer's realigned CMS/PPS segments by FY2019-2020, and the retiree medical plan was wound down — none of which documents product/process incoherence (p4=0) or an operations-vs-organization fracture over time (p5=0). The only substantive adverse items are a since-remediated deferred-tax internal-control material weakness and a pre-acquisition Australian JV subcontract dispute (originating 2012, terminated Jan 2017) that settled in April 2022; both are financial/legacy-contingency matters, not documented realized disruptions at the product/process or process/organization interface. No evidence of controlling-intent archetype incoherence (t1=0) or irreconcilable business-model conflict (t2=0) appears in the slice.

gemini.performance_metric: cash payment of approximately $475 million for legacy CH2M matter
gemini.rationale: The provided slice documents the integration of CH2M into the acquirer's reporting segments by fiscal 2019 without noting any product/process disruption (p4=0). Furthermore, there is no evidence of process/organization fracture, as the only major post-deal issues reported were a remediated material weakness in tax controls and a pre-acquisition legal settlement (p5=0).

openai.performance_metric: approximately $475 million cash settlement paid in April 2022
openai.rationale: No realized product/process-interface disruption is documented; by fiscal 2019 CH2M's businesses had been folded into the CMS and PPS segments, and the fiscal 2020 filing contained no narrative CH2M trajectory. The acquisition-related deferred-tax control weakness was reported as remediated in fiscal 2019, so the slice documents no continuing process/organization fracture at the 3–5-year horizon. The principal CH2M-specific outcome in that window was settlement of a pre-acquisition legal contingency, not an integration-interface failure.
